_doc: Talents for the specs of skills-specs-4.json (docs/TALENTS.md): the new talent rows of each spec tree. The older passive/synergy rows of those trees stay in skills-specs-4.json.

wyr_thawing_heat.name: Thawing Heat
wyr_thawing_heat.flavour: Ice cracks loudest when it is warm.

wyr_pyre_keeper.name: Pyre Keeper
wyr_pyre_keeper.flavour: The furnace never quite goes out.

tnk_shared_bolts.name: Shared Bolts
tnk_shared_bolts.flavour: The sentries get the good quarrels too.

tnk_the_mainspring.name: The Mainspring
tnk_the_mainspring.flavour: Wound once. Never quite runs down.

tnk_grand_design.name: Grand Design
tnk_grand_design.flavour: Every bolt in the right hole, first time.

tnk_perpetual_motion.name: Perpetual Motion
tnk_perpetual_motion.flavour: They said it could not be built.

chr_early_fire.name: Early Fire
chr_early_fire.flavour: The bolt left before you thought of it.

chr_spare_seconds.name: Spare Seconds
chr_spare_seconds.flavour: Kept in a pocket for later.

chr_stalled_storm.name: Stalled Storm
chr_stalled_storm.flavour: The cloud forgets to move on.

chr_the_last_hour.name: The Last Hour
chr_the_last_hour.flavour: Everything winds down. You just help.

spk_post_singer.name: Post Singer
spk_post_singer.flavour: The posts hum the bolt's note.

spk_the_elder_post.name: The Elder Post
spk_the_elder_post.flavour: Older than the village that carved it.

spk_voice_of_thousands.name: Voice of Thousands
spk_voice_of_thousands.flavour: They were only waiting to be asked.

spk_the_open_door.name: The Open Door
spk_the_open_door.flavour: Nobody knocks. They just come in.

mnk_hands_past_counting.name: Hands Past Counting
mnk_hands_past_counting.flavour: A hundred was only where they stopped counting.

mnk_the_ninth_turn.name: The Ninth Turn
mnk_the_ninth_turn.flavour: Eight turns to learn it. One to use it.
